liner.body_md:
## What listeners single out

- **Cold Rain And Snow** (1 review): Reviewer loved the unpredictable opening of Cold Rain and Snow followed by It's All Over Now [10]
- **Crazy Fingers** (1 review): Reviewer was listening to the Crazy Fingers into Estimated Prophet segment and loved it [16]
- Reviewer says Jerry's singing was the best they had ever heard from him [6]

## The recordings

- **gd1994-03-20.nak300.wankelsworth.10539.sbeok.shnf** (recommended): audience recording; 19 songs; 162 min; rated 5/5 by 2 [1]. Said about its sound: Has a modest amount of conversation and audience distraction typical of front-of-board-area audience tapes; less noisy than the other source; Uploader describes this audience tape as paper thin, suited only to completists and attendees [1][11]
- **gd94-03-20.schoeps.ladner.15464.sbeok.shnf**: audience recording; 19 songs; 158 min; rated 3.25/5 by 12 [2]. Said about its sound: Reviewer calls it an excellent audience recording, with one exception left unstated in the excerpt; Reviewer finds the sound awful, comparing it to a smuggled tape recorder bootleg of a Doobie Brothers show; Apart from occasional crowd noise, the recording has energy [6][8][10]
- **gd1994-03-20.110567.bk.schmit.sbeok.flac16**: source not stated; 9 songs; 57 min [5]
- **gd1994-03-20.130902.boedicker.flac16**: audience recording; 19 songs; 161 min [3]

## Around the show

- Reviewer attended as a high school senior; it was their first Dead show and they have been a fan since [9]
- Parking lot scene was memorable: undercover agents on the Coliseum roof, grilled cheese, and a lively Shakedown Street [14]
- It was the reviewer's first Dead show with a ticket of their own [14]
- Reviewer owns hundreds of recordings but no other 1994 show; calls this run's two nights special, this being the second [6]
- Recommends the 6-9-91 He's Gone to anyone who likes the version from this night [7]
- This Nakamichi 300 version has less crowd noise than the Schoeps cardioid version, which is somewhat peppier [11]

## Tapers and lineage

- **gd1994-03-20.nak300.wankelsworth.10539.sbeok.shnf**: transferred by Chris Ladner; source: AUD(Nak 300s)>DAT>CDR>WAV>SHNv3 [1]. Also: Seed from Henry Wankleswurth; transferred with DAE, boundary-checked with shntool, and encoded to SHN via an FTP site [1]
- **gd94-03-20.schoeps.ladner.15464.sbeok.shnf**: transferred by M.Ratliff; source: Audience: Schoeps CMC34's [2]. Also: Audience source: Schoeps CMC34 microphones through Oade preamp to SV255 DAT, then CDR, WAV and SHN; via M. Ratliff, seeded by neolevo [2]
- **gd1994-03-20.110567.bk.schmit.sbeok.flac16**: taped by Alan Schmit; transferred by Terry Watts; source: Set 1 Source: (handheld/ORTF/110^/DFC/FOB/17th Row) B&K 4011s > Neumann BS48i-2 > TCD-D3 > DAT(m) [5]. Also: Front-of-board recording from the Schmit and Lamke collection; the missing set II tape was found and is being transferred [12]
- **gd1994-03-20.130902.boedicker.flac16**: taped by Dave Boedicker; transferred by Dave Boedicker; source: Source:Audience Recording(Sony Wm D6C Cassette Deck>Nakamichi 300 Mics W/CP4 Shotgun Mics)> Cassette Master>Sony TC-D5M Cassette Deck(Playback)>Edirol R-09… [3]

## Art and photos

- Poster by Jerry Garcia: [1994-03-20 Grateful Dead Backstage Pass - Jerry Garcia](https://jerrygarcia.com/image/1994-03-20-grateful-dead-backstage-pass/) [19]
